parts.title: Orientation
parts.summary: What Biblical Hebrew is, which Hebrew this guide teaches, the root-and-pattern idea and the narrative chain, and where the facts come from.

parts.title: Sounds and script
parts.summary: The square script and its consonants, the Tiberian vowel points, shewa, dagesh and begadkefat, syllables, stress and pause, the accents as punctuation, and the transliteration used in the guide.

parts.title: The simplest sentences
parts.summary: Sentences without a verb, the article, 'and', the personal pronouns, the prefixed prepositions, a first verb form, negation, yes/no questions and the object marker.

parts.title: Nouns and their machinery
parts.summary: Gender, plural and dual, how noun vowels shift, segholates, the construct state, pronoun suffixes on nouns and prepositions, demonstratives, adjectives and the common irregular nouns.

parts.title: Verbs: the core system
parts.summary: The qatal and yiqtol conjugations, the wayyiqtol and weqatal chains and the debate over what they mean, commands and wishes, participles and infinitives, the weak verb classes, object suffixes and the derived stems.

parts.title: Modifying and linking
parts.summary: Adverbs and focus particles, nouns used as adverbs, numbers, comparison, quantifiers, compound prepositions, kî, clauses that break the chain, and hinnēh and wayhî.

parts.title: Complex sentences
parts.summary: Question words, relative clauses, purpose, time, cause and condition, reported speech, oaths and wishes, and how a narrative episode is built.

parts.title: Advanced and special topics
parts.summary: The meaning of the stems, rarer stems, the infinitive absolute, the text behind the page, poetry, Late Biblical Hebrew, the history of the vowels, word formation, inscriptions, and Biblical Aramaic and later Hebrew.

parts.title: Reading real texts
parts.summary: Eight graded passages from Ruth, Samuel, Jonah, Genesis, Deuteronomy, the Psalms and Qohelet, ending with the creation story of Genesis 1.

parts.title: Reference
parts.summary: Paradigm tables, glossary of terms and abbreviations, annotated bibliography.

lessons.title: What Biblical Hebrew is
lessons.point: Place Biblical Hebrew in time, space and family, and know which Hebrew, and which reading of it, this guide teaches

lessons.title: The organising idea: roots, patterns and the narrative chain
lessons.point: See how three consonants and a vowel pattern make a word, and how a story moves by a chain of 'and he did' verbs

lessons.title: How to use this guide and where its facts come from
lessons.point: Read the examples, transliteration, glosses, confidence labels and verse citations used throughout

lessons.title: The consonant letters and the direction of writing
lessons.point: Recognise the 22 letters and their five final forms, and read a line from right to left

lessons.title: The sounds of the consonants
lessons.point: Pronounce each consonant as this guide does, and know how the Tiberian, biblical-period and modern pronunciations differ

lessons.title: The vowel points
lessons.point: Read the full vowels of the Tiberian pointing and know what the dots and dashes record

lessons.title: Vowel letters: full and defective spelling
lessons.point: Read the consonants that double as vowel signs and see why the same word can be spelled two ways

lessons.title: Shewa and the reduced vowels
lessons.point: Tell vocal shewa from silent shewa and read the three hatef vowels

lessons.title: Syllables, vowel length and qameṣ ḥaṭuf
lessons.point: Divide a word into syllables and read qameṣ correctly as ā or o

lessons.title: Dagesh: doubling and the six soft letters
lessons.point: Tell a doubling dot from a hardening dot and pronounce b g d k p t hard or soft

lessons.title: Stress, maqqef and pause
lessons.point: Find the stressed syllable, read words joined by maqqef, and recognise pausal forms

lessons.title: The accents as punctuation, and ketiv and qere
lessons.point: Use the main disjunctive accents to divide a verse, and read a word whose margin note corrects its letters

lessons.title: The guide's transliteration, and reading Genesis 1:1–3 aloud
lessons.point: Write and read any pointed word in the guide's transliteration and read a first verse aloud

lessons.title: Saying what something is: sentences without a verb
lessons.point: Make a sentence from two nouns or a noun and an adjective, with no word for 'is'

lessons.title: The article: ha- and the doubling it causes
lessons.point: Make a noun definite and predict the article's form before any consonant

lessons.title: 'And': the prefix wə- and its other forms
lessons.point: Join words and clauses with wə-, and know when it becomes û or wā

lessons.title: The personal pronouns
lessons.point: Use I, you, he, she, we and they as the subject of a sentence without a verb

lessons.title: The prefixed prepositions bə-, lə-, kə- and min
lessons.point: Say in, to, like and from, and merge them with the article

lessons.title: A first verb form: qatal, 'he did'
lessons.point: Make a past statement with the third-person qatal and put the verb first

lessons.title: Negation, and 'there is' and 'there is not'
lessons.point: Negate a verb with lōʾ, and say that something exists or does not with yēš and ʾên

lessons.title: Yes/no questions
lessons.point: Turn a statement into a question with hă- and answer it

lessons.title: The object marker ʾēt
lessons.point: Mark a definite object and see why an indefinite one is left bare

lessons.title: Masculine and feminine
lessons.point: Tell a noun's gender from its ending, and know the feminine nouns that show no ending

lessons.title: Plural and dual
lessons.point: Make plurals in -îm and -ôt and duals in -ayim, and know why the vowels shift

lessons.title: Why noun vowels change
lessons.point: Predict how a noun's vowels shorten as endings are added

lessons.title: Segholate nouns: melek, sēper, qōdeš
lessons.point: Recognise the commonest noun type and build its plural and suffixed forms

lessons.title: The construct state: 'the word of the king'
lessons.point: Join two nouns so that the first belongs to the second

lessons.title: Construct chains and the construct plural
lessons.point: Build longer chains, make them definite, and form the construct plural and feminine

lessons.title: Pronoun suffixes on singular nouns
lessons.point: Say my, your, his, her, our and their with endings on a singular noun

lessons.title: Pronoun suffixes on plural nouns
lessons.point: Add the possessive endings to plural and dual nouns

lessons.title: Pronoun suffixes on prepositions and on ʾēt
lessons.point: Say to me, with him, from them, and use ʾōtô for 'him' as object

lessons.title: This and that: the demonstratives
lessons.point: Point to something near or far, before or after its noun

lessons.title: Adjectives: describing and stating
lessons.point: Make an adjective describe a noun or state something about it, and make it agree

lessons.title: The common irregular nouns
lessons.point: Use father, brother, man, woman, son, daughter, house, day and city in all their forms

lessons.title: Roots and the seven stems
lessons.point: See how one root is spread across up to seven verb stems with related meanings

lessons.title: The qatal conjugation in full
lessons.point: Build all persons of qatal and know why its endings look like pronouns

lessons.title: The yiqtol conjugation
lessons.point: Build all persons of yiqtol, with its prefixes and endings, and read it as 'will do' or 'used to do'

lessons.title: Wayyiqtol: the narrative chain
lessons.point: Tell a story in the past with 'and he did, and he did'

lessons.title: Weqatal: the chain of instructions and futures
lessons.point: Continue a command or a future with 'and you will do'

lessons.title: What qatal, yiqtol, wayyiqtol and weqatal mean: tense, aspect or discourse?
lessons.point: Know what the forms do in prose, why scholars disagree about the system, and how this guide talks about it

lessons.title: The imperative
lessons.point: Give a command to one or several people, masculine or feminine

lessons.title: Wishes and resolves: jussive, cohortative and nāʾ
lessons.point: Say 'let him do', 'let me do' and 'do not', and recognise the short and lengthened forms

lessons.title: The participle
lessons.point: Use the qal active and passive participle as noun, adjective and 'is doing'

lessons.title: The infinitive construct
lessons.point: Say 'to do' with lə- and 'when he did' with bə- or kə-

lessons.title: Verbs with guttural root letters
lessons.point: Predict the vowel changes when a root contains ʾ, h, ḥ, ʿ or r

lessons.title: Verbs beginning with ʾ or n: ʾāmar, nāpal, nātan
lessons.point: Recognise wayyōʾmer, yippōl and yittēn and know where the missing letter went

lessons.title: Verbs beginning with y: yāšab, yādaʿ, yāṣāʾ
lessons.point: Recognise the short stems of the commonest weak verbs

lessons.title: Hollow verbs: qûm, śîm, bôʾ
lessons.point: Conjugate verbs whose middle root letter is a vowel

lessons.title: Verbs ending in -â: bānâ, ʿāśâ, rāʾâ
lessons.point: Conjugate the largest weak class and recognise its short forms wayyar and wayyaʿaś

lessons.title: Doubled roots and the irregular verbs hālak and lāqaḥ
lessons.point: Recognise forms of sabab, hālak and lāqaḥ that look like other roots

lessons.title: Hāyâ: 'be', 'become', and wayhî
lessons.point: Use hāyâ for past and future being, and know why the present needs no verb

lessons.title: Pronoun suffixes on verbs
lessons.point: Attach 'me', 'him', 'them' to a verb and read the vowel changes it causes

lessons.title: The niphal: passive and middle
lessons.point: Build the niphal and use it for 'was done', 'did to oneself' and some plain verbs

lessons.title: The piel and pual: the doubled stems
lessons.point: Build the piel and its passive and know what the doubled middle letter adds

lessons.title: The hiphil and hophal: making happen
lessons.point: Build the causative stem and its passive

lessons.title: The hithpael: doing to or for oneself
lessons.point: Build the reflexive and reciprocal stem and its metathesis

lessons.title: Weak verbs in the derived stems
lessons.point: Recognise hēqîm, hôšîaʿ, hibbîṭ, nôlad and hēbîʾ and find their roots

lessons.title: Adverbs and focus particles
lessons.point: Use now, there, thus, also, only and surely, and place them in the clause

lessons.title: Nouns as adverbs: the directional -â and bare time and place words
lessons.point: Say 'to Egypt', 'that day' and 'in the morning' without a preposition

lessons.title: Numbers one to ten
lessons.point: Count things, and see why three to ten take the 'wrong' gender

lessons.title: Higher numbers, ordinals and dates
lessons.point: Say ages, years and the days of creation

lessons.title: Comparison: 'more than' and 'most'
lessons.point: Compare with min and express the superlative without a special form

lessons.title: Kol and other quantifiers
lessons.point: Say all, every, each, any and none

lessons.title: The fuller prepositions
lessons.point: Use before, after, under, upon, with and between, including the compound ones made from nouns

lessons.title: Kî: that, because, when, indeed
lessons.point: Read the commonest linking word in each of its senses

lessons.title: Breaking the chain: wə- plus a noun
lessons.point: Mark background, contrast and simultaneous events by putting something other than a verb after wə-

lessons.title: Hinnēh and wayhî: pointing and setting the scene
lessons.point: Use hinnēh for 'look' and a character's point of view, and wayhî to set a time frame

lessons.title: Question words
lessons.point: Ask who, what, where, why, when and how

lessons.title: Relative clauses with ʾăšer
lessons.point: Describe a noun with a clause, using a pronoun to mark the gap

lessons.title: Relatives without ʾăšer, and the participle as relative
lessons.point: Read relative clauses with no relative word and 'the one who does' with the article and participle

lessons.title: Purpose: 'so that' and 'lest'
lessons.point: Say why something is done with lə-, ləmaʿan, and pen

lessons.title: Time clauses
lessons.point: Say when, after, until and before

lessons.title: Cause and result
lessons.point: Say because and therefore

lessons.title: Conditional sentences
lessons.point: Say if and if only, real and unreal, and continue the result with weqatal

lessons.title: Speech and reported speech
lessons.point: Introduce speech with lēʾmōr, and report what someone said, saw or knew

lessons.title: Oaths, wishes and strong assertions
lessons.point: Read oath formulas, 'if only' and 'may it be' sentences

lessons.title: The anatomy of a narrative episode
lessons.point: Follow how setting, mainline, background, speech and climax are marked in a whole scene

lessons.title: What the stems mean
lessons.point: Predict and also distrust the meaning of a stem from its form

lessons.title: The rarer stems and four-letter roots
lessons.point: Recognise polel, hithpolel, pilpel and the other minor stems

lessons.title: The infinitive absolute
lessons.point: Read 'he surely died', 'going and weeping' and the infinitive used as a command

lessons.title: The text behind the page: Masoretes, ketiv and qere, and the divine name
lessons.point: Know what the Masoretic text is, how its notes work, and how YHWH and Jerusalem are pointed and read

lessons.title: Poetry I: lines and parallelism
lessons.point: Divide a poem into lines and see how paired lines answer each other

lessons.title: Poetry II: the grammar of poetry and archaic forms
lessons.point: Read poetic verb use and old forms such as -mô, ʾēl and zû

lessons.title: Late Biblical Hebrew
lessons.point: Recognise the Hebrew of Chronicles, Ezra–Nehemiah, Esther and Qohelet and what changed

lessons.title: Why the vowels behave as they do: a short history
lessons.point: Explain the main vowel alternations from the sound changes behind them

lessons.title: Word formation: noun patterns and endings
lessons.point: Guess the meaning of a new noun from its pattern and endings

lessons.title: Hebrew outside the Bible: inscriptions and the old script
lessons.point: Read a short Iron Age inscription and know the Palaeo-Hebrew letters

lessons.title: Biblical Aramaic, and Hebrew after the Bible
lessons.point: Recognise the Aramaic chapters, and see how Rabbinic and Modern Hebrew differ

lessons.title: Reading 1: Ruth 1:1–5
lessons.point: Read a plain narrative opening built almost entirely of wayyiqtol

lessons.title: Reading 2: 1 Samuel 3:1–10
lessons.point: Read a narrative with dialogue, background clauses and repetition

lessons.title: Reading 3: Jonah 1:1–6
lessons.point: Read a story with commands, purpose clauses and a storm

lessons.title: Reading 4: Genesis 22:1–8
lessons.point: Read a tightly told episode with a pause on every word

lessons.title: Reading 5: Deuteronomy 6:4–9, the Shema
lessons.point: Read a chain of weqatal instructions and pronoun suffixes

lessons.title: Reading 6: Psalm 23
lessons.point: Read a short poem line by line

lessons.title: Reading 7: Qohelet 1:1–11
lessons.point: Read Late Biblical Hebrew reflective prose and verse

lessons.title: Capstone: Genesis 1:1–2:3, the creation
lessons.point: Read the creation story with its refrains, numbers and jussives

lessons.title: Tables: nouns, pronouns, suffixes and particles
lessons.point: Look up any nominal or pronominal form

lessons.title: Tables: the strong verb and the weak verb classes
lessons.point: Look up any verb form in any stem

lessons.title: Glossary of terms and abbreviations
lessons.point: Look up any technical term or gloss abbreviation used in the guide

lessons.title: Annotated bibliography
lessons.point: Know what each source is and where to go next
